out: Updated to 0.11.0 from 0.10.2 yesterday. New since then (use these; about_atlas has the full list):
Standing bots are the user's team: each has its own instructions, access and daily budget, and you can see them in the brief ("Standing bots").
Missions split into agents and sub-agents that work in parallel; a checker reviews a bot's report before the user sees it.
A bot that used up today's budget stops and asks; give it more only when the user says so.
Standing bots resume after the phone restarts; a step that was cut off half-way is marked for checking, never simply repeated.
